reviews.title: A Quite Amazing Little App
reviews.text: I started 73 days ago.  I have been working up to this for a long time.  Did not like not having my life.  This app has everything you could think of to keep on straight and honest.  Even breathing exercises!  A daily journal that allows you to record your successes (or not).  Thank you.  73 days clean and really feeling like I have left it behind.  But I will do the activities, the journal and the motivational reminders that I created( and can set them to repeat during the day).  It is truly an amazing app.  Of course I could not make this happen without God, Jesus and prayer.  Think about that.

reviews.title: Best App of It’s Type
reviews.text: I don’t normally write reviews but I have to in this case. This app is absolutely fantastic…it has a great community of likeminded individuals who can offer help, support, and encouragement for you in your journey to overcome your addiction. Further, it has a built-in content blocker extension for safari, video playlists to help you understand what led to your addiction and to help you overcome it, private mentors to offer advice if needed, and many challenges to participate in/badges to earn to visualize your progress. Finally, I had a question about the app, emailed the developer, and they returned my email and personally answered my questions within 24 hours. I HIGHLY recommend this app for anyone struggling with addiction.
